newsitem.title: UK: Prudential set to win race for ScotAm - paper.
newsitem.headline: Prudential set to win race for ScotAm - paper.

text.p: Mutually-owned insurance group Scottish Amicable will announce later that Prudential Corp Plc has won the 2.0 billion stg ($3.22 billion) bidding war, the Financial Times said on Tuesday.

The two other bidders are Abbey National Plc and Australian Mutual Provident (AMP). The paper said terms will be revealed after ScotAm's 1.1 million policyholders have received details of bonuses linked to the offer.

The paper said the deal will be more than the initial 1.9 billion stg offered by Prudential in February, and attention will focus on what is on offer above the life fund injection, and the 400 million stg distribution of ScotAm's assets.
